preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 100.
The number of nodes n in the tree must be between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= k1 <= n and all(1 <= x <= n for x in x1)
preconditions.description: The number of nodes in your subtree k1 must be between 1 and n, and all x_i must be valid node indices.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= k2 <= n and all(1 <= y <= n for y in y1)
preconditions.description: The number of nodes in Li Chen's subtree k2 must be between 1 and n, and all y_i must be valid node indices.

postconditions.description: The output must be either 'C s' where s is a common vertex label or 'C -1' if no common vertex exists.

postconditions.expression: any(x in x1 for x in y1)
postconditions.description: If there is a common vertex, it must be present in both your subtree and Li Chen's subtree.

postconditions.expression: len([q for q in queries if q.startswith('A') or q.startswith('B')]) <= 5
postconditions.description: The total number of queries asked must not exceed 5.
